## Frequently Asked Questions & Verified Data

### Q: What is the exact location of Kumar Magnacity?
A: Kumar Magnacity is located on Manjari Road, in Hadapsar Annexe (Manjari Budruk), East Pune, Maharashtra 412307. The exact geographical coordinates are 18.4948931° N latitude and 73.9828496° E longitude.

### Q: What configurations are available and what is the starting price?
A: 
- 2 BHK Luxury Apartments: 757 Sq.Ft carpet area starting at ₹72.99 Lakhs*.
- 3 BHK Luxury Apartments: 1,053 Sq.Ft carpet area starting at ₹1.05 Crore*.
- 4 BHK & Sky Duplex Penthouses: Expansive double-height layouts on top floors.
- NA Villa Bungalow Plots: 1,700 Sq.Ft to 3,500+ Sq.Ft starting at ₹1.49 Crore*.

### Q: Is there an on-campus school at Kumar Magnacity?
A: Yes, the world-renowned Podar International School operates a full-scale K-12 CBSE campus directly inside the 150-acre township gates, offering zero-commute walk-to-school safety for children.

### Q: What are the MahaRERA numbers?
A: 
- Residential High-Rise Towers: MahaRERA Registration No. P52100052096
- NA Villa Bungalow Plots: MahaRERA Registration No. P52100054476
All projects are 100% verified on the official MahaRERA portal at maharera.mahaonline.gov.in.

### Q: How far is Kumar Magnacity from major IT parks in Pune?
A:
- Magarpatta Cybercity: ~6 km (10 to 12 minutes drive)
- Kharadi EON IT Park & WTC: ~7.5 km (15 minutes drive via Manjari-Kharadi Bridge)
- SP Infocity Phursungi: ~6.5 km (12 minutes drive)

### Q: What is the Google rating of Magnacity by Kumar Realty?
A: Magnacity by Kumar Realty holds an outstanding 4.9 / 5.0 Star rating backed by 386+ verified Google reviews.
